result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but there are several visual inconsistencies: truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, an inconsistent/low-contrast favorite button, a promo card image with an inconsistent placeholder background, and the second 'Popular right now' card is clipped by the bottom navigation with no visible details.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (the −20% pizza) is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its name, rating and delivery info are not visible and the image appears abruptly sliced.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scroll container equal to the bottom nav height so the last card can fully scroll into view above the tab bar.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styles: the first is a dark heart on a white circle, the second is a white heart on a dark translucent circle, which looks like a rendering/state error and reduces contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button style (e.g. white circle with dark outlined heart, filled red when active) across all cards.

issues.description: The third card title in 'Fastest near you' reads 'Trattoria Piccol' — clipped at the viewport edge with no ellipsis, so it looks broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card width, and give the carousel a trailing peek/padding so partially visible cards read as scrollable content.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light gray background while the sibling thumbnails are dark, making it look like a missing/placeholder image. Its time badge also has weaker contrast against the light background.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (consistent aspect ratio and background/overlay) and ensure badges keep a solid background for contrast on light imagery.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no visible affordance that it scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or a fade/gradient edge so the cut chip clearly signals scrollable content.
